messages:
Alex Chen: FYI BetterBank renewal in 18 days. Usage down ~40% past 30d, sessions dropping. Thinking a quick activation + targeted enablement + a one-off credit to re-engage. Need volunteers to run an audit, lead enablement, and coordinate pricing. Thoughts?
Priya Nair: Can you paste the key metrics? DAUs, top routes, last production deploy time? :eyes: 
Alex Chen: Quick snapshot:
- DAU: 520 -> 310 (30d)
- Token/day: 2.1M -> 1.3M
- Top route: /generate (latency fine)
- Billing risk: overage spike last month, then drop
Jonah Blake: I can scope the pricing concession. We usually offer a one-off credit or 2-week discount. If we do credit, need AM approval and renewal note. :thumbsup: 
Wei Zhang: I can run a focused enablement session. Proposed agenda:
1) 30m ops review (usage patterns)
2) 30m prompts & integration tips
3) Action plan + follow-up metrics
Prefer Wed or Thu this week.
Samira Flores: I'll run the usage audit and surface exact queries + sample failing prompts. Will need SQL access — pinging eng-analytics if not open. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Alex Chen: Samira, include funnel: sign-in -> init call -> long running prompts. Wei, Wed works. Jonah, do you need a customer note to justify credit?
Jonah Blake: Yes a short note on how credit ties to reactivation + proof points. I'll draft and loop in sales legal. Can we commit to one of: 20% 2-week discount OR a $X credit? Which is less friction?
Priya Nair: Ops preference = credit (single ledger item). Less product change. I'll prep the one-off credit flow doc snippet.
Alex Chen: Samira — run this query to get daily active orgs + avg tokens
```sql
SELECT date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as dau, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM events
WHERE org_id = 'betterbank'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Samira Flores: Got it. Also will export top 10 prompts for last 30d.
cs-bot: Reminder: Renewal team checkbox "activation session scheduled" not set for BetterBank. Use /renewal-touch to update.
Alex Chen: Action items:
- Samira: audit + top prompts (due EOD tomorrow)
- Wei: enablement session (book Wed or Thu) + agenda
- Jonah: pricing note & draft credit language
- Priya: credit flow doc & renewal update
I'll run the customer outreach and propose Wed 3pm PT. Ping here when you add calendar invites. Thanks all :rocket:
Priya Nair: Added to my list, will update renewal checklist once credit flow is confirmed. :white_check_mark: 
Jonah Blake: Draft ready, sending to Alex for review.
Wei Zhang: Booked Wed 3pm PT. Added calendar invite.
Samira Flores: Audit uploaded to cs-drive (private). Shared link in DM to Alex. Done.
Alex Chen: Great — keep me posted. If usage doesn't lift by renewal we'll prepare a 60-day downgrade path (outline ready).
